title.en: Nickel sourcing and Indigenous land in Sulawesi
title.zh: 蘇拉威西鎳礦供應鏈與原住民族土地

rights_holders.zh: 蘇拉威西原住民族社群

focus.en: An investigation traced nickel through processing facilities to vehicle manufacturers. The case follows the reported land impacts and each actor’s response.
focus.zh: 調查報導追溯鎳礦從加工廠到車廠的流向。本案追蹤報導提出的土地影響及各方回應。

follow_up.en: Revisit the case page after Huayou’s stated November 30 response deadline. Look for the response and the affected communities’ assessment.
follow_up.zh: 華友表示 11 月 30 日前回覆。屆期回查原始案件頁，並尋找受影響社群對處理措施的評價。

sources.publisher: BMW via Business and Human Rights Centre

text.en: The Centre published a case page about alleged land loss linked to nickel sourcing.
text.zh: 中心刊出鎳礦採購與原住民族土地流失指控的案件頁。
中心刊出 BMW 回應。

text.en: The Centre recorded no response to its invitation as of this entry.
text.zh: 中心記錄該次詢問截至登錄時尚未獲回應。

text.en: The Centre says Huayou committed to reply by November 30. The date of the commitment is unspecified.
text.zh: 中心記載華友表示將於 11 月 30 日前回覆。承諾作成日期未載明。

title.en: Consultation and the Mejuruá carbon project
title.zh: Mejuruá 碳權專案與原住民族諮商

rights_holders.en: Indigenous peoples and traditional communities in Carauari
rights_holders.zh: Carauari 的原住民族與傳統社群

focus.en: Brazil’s federal prosecutors describe a dispute over land and consultation in a carbon credit project in Amazonas.
focus.zh: 巴西聯邦檢察機關公布碳權專案涉及土地與諮商權的訴訟。

follow_up.en: Check the court docket and community statements for orders, implementation and evidence of land access.
follow_up.zh: 回查法院卷宗與社群聲明，追蹤裁定、執行情形及社群使用土地的證據。

sources.publisher: Verra via Business and Human Rights Centre

text.en: Prosecutors announced a civil action against BR Arbo and Verra and requested suspension of the project.
text.zh: 檢察機關公布對 BR Arbo 與 Verra 提起民事訴訟，並請求暫停專案。

text.en: Verra stated that it had received no notice of proceedings and had no comment at that time.
text.zh: Verra 表示當時尚未收到訴訟通知，暫無評論。

title.en: Giant Taiwan bicycles and the US customs order
title.zh: 巨大在臺製造自行車與美國海關暫扣令

rights_holders.en: Workers in Giant’s Taiwan manufacturing operations
rights_holders.zh: 巨大在臺製造據點的勞工

focus.en: Follow the goods covered by the US customs order, the company’s responses and the evidence on worker outcomes.
focus.zh: 追蹤美國海關命令涵蓋的產品、公司回應及勞工實際處境。

follow_up.en: Review the latest CBP disposition and seek worker-side evidence of fee reimbursement and its coverage.
follow_up.zh: 回查美國海關後續處置，並尋找勞工端可佐證招募費返還及涵蓋範圍的資料。

text.en: CBP ordered detention at US ports of specified bicycles, parts and accessories manufactured by Giant in Taiwan, citing indications of forced labour.
text.zh: CBP 以有強迫勞動跡象為由，要求美國入境港口暫扣巨大在臺製造的指定自行車、零件及配件。

text.en: Giant reported meeting CBP and supplying documentation for review. The company published its account on March 9.
text.zh: 巨大表示已與 CBP 會面並提供審查文件，公司於 3 月 9 日發布說明。

title.en: Wage claims following the Bathla Group collapse
title.zh: Bathla 集團進入管理程序後的工資請求

rights_holders.en: Former construction group employees, including temporary visa holders
rights_holders.zh: 建築集團離職員工，包含臨時簽證持有人

focus.en: Former employees and administrators described outstanding entitlements during voluntary administration in Australia.
focus.zh: 澳洲建築集團進入自願管理程序後，離職員工與管理人說明待釐清的工資及給付。

follow_up.en: Check administrator and creditor updates for actual distributions and whether temporary visa holders are included.
follow_up.zh: 查核管理人與債權人公告的實際給付，另查臨時簽證勞工是否納入。

text.en: Administrators told ABC they had secured funds for a partial wage payment covering work after their appointment.
text.zh: 管理人向 ABC 表示，已取得支付接管後部分工資的資金。

text.en: Former employees described outstanding pay and uncertainty over recovery. ABC also reported the administrators’ explanation for delays.
text.zh: 離職員工向 ABC 說明仍有薪資待領及求償的不確定性，報導亦引述管理人對延誤的說明。

title.en: Collective bargaining at the GM Silao facility
title.zh: GM 墨西哥 Silao 廠集體協商

rights_holders.en: Workers at General Motors’ Silao facility
rights_holders.zh: 通用汽車 Silao 工廠勞工

focus.en: A historical comparison case with a documented remediation plan and subsequent votes at a single facility.
focus.zh: 歷史比較案例。美墨雙方針對單一工廠訂定補救程序，後續有勞工投票紀錄。

follow_up.en: For a longitudinal study, seek worker or union evidence about implementation of the new agreement.
follow_up.zh: 如延伸追蹤履約，另蒐集工會或勞工對新協約執行情形的紀錄。

text.en: The governments announced a remediation plan for the bargaining agreement vote at the facility.
text.zh: 美墨兩國公布有關該廠集體協約投票的補救計畫。

text.en: USTR reported that workers selected a new union in the February 1–2 vote.
text.zh: USTR 記錄勞工在 2 月 1 至 2 日投票選出新的工會。

text.en: USTR’s May 27 statement reported worker approval of a newly negotiated collective agreement.
text.zh: USTR 在 5 月 27 日聲明中記錄勞工投票通過新集體協約。
